name: Boreal — Music Recognizer
description: Recognize music in the current tab. Local Rust fingerprints, listening history, CSV export, and Nord or dark themes.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'self' https://amp.shazam.com; img-src 'self' https://*.mzstatic.com https://*.shazam.com; base-uri 'none'
